day3_night_start.name: Me
day3_night_start.text: *I'm home. Friday night... Tomorrow starts the weekend.*

day3_night_reflect.name: Me
day3_night_reflect.text: *Lying on the bed, I reflect on today. What happened at lunch... what happened after school...*

day3_night_reflect_trouble.name: Me
day3_night_reflect_trouble.text: *Everyone found out at lunch... Can the weekend go smoothly?*

day3_night_reflect_tension.name: Me
day3_night_reflect_tension.text: *I made multiple plans... I need to manage my time well.*

day3_night_reflect_normal.name: Me
day3_night_reflect_normal.text: *I'm looking forward to tomorrow. What kind of day will it be?*

day3_night_phone_check.name: Me
day3_night_phone_check.text: *I check my smartphone. There are messages.*

day3_night_multiple_messages.name: Me
day3_night_multiple_messages.text: *There are multiple messages... My heart is pounding.*

day3_night_msg_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_msg_seoyeon.text: *Message: 10 PM* '{name}, are you still awake? I'm so excited for tomorrow!'

day3_night_seoyeon_suspicious.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_suspicious.text: *Additional message* 'But... you're only meeting me, right? No other plans?'

day3_night_seoyeon_lie.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_lie.text: 'Really? I trust you! See you tomorrow! 💕'

day3_night_seoyeon_honest.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_honest.text: '...What? You have other plans? With who?'

day3_night_seoyeon_ignore.name: Me
day3_night_seoyeon_ignore.text: *I didn't reply. Seoyeon will probably be disappointed...*

day3_night_seoyeon_jealous.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_jealous.text: *Additional message* 'About lunch today... it's still bothering me. Please be honest with me.'
choices: 'Sorry, I couldn't say no to anyone...'

day3_night_seoyeon_apologize.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_apologize.text: '...Thanks for being honest. But I don't like sharing with others.'

day3_night_seoyeon_reassure.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_reassure.text: '...Really? I'll remember that. Prove it tomorrow.'

day3_night_seoyeon_normal.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_normal.text: 'Have you decided where to go tomorrow? You can leave it to me! Good night! 😊'
choices: 'I'll leave it to you! Good night!'

day3_night_yuna_witnessed.name: Yuna
day3_night_yuna_witnessed.text: *Additional message* 'Today after school... I saw you leaving with Seoyeon.'

day3_night_yuna_warning.name: Yuna
day3_night_yuna_warning.text: 'If you lie to me... you'll regret it.'

day3_night_yuna_reassure.name: Yuna
day3_night_yuna_reassure.text: '...Really? I'll believe that. But if you betray me...'

day3_night_yuna_apologize.name: Yuna
day3_night_yuna_apologize.text: '...We'll talk when we meet tomorrow. Don't run away.'

day3_night_yuna_knows.name: Yuna
day3_night_yuna_knows.text: *Additional message* '...You made promises with others too, didn't you?'

day3_night_yuna_knows_2.name: Yuna
day3_night_yuna_knows_2.text: 'It's okay. You'll come to me in the end.'

day3_night_msg_dain.name: Dain
day3_night_msg_dain.text: *Message: 9 PM* 'Hey!! 9 AM at the gym tomorrow!! Don't be late!!! 😤'

day3_night_dain_suspicious.name: Dain
day3_night_dain_suspicious.text: *Additional message* 'But... did you really make plans with others too? I heard at lunch.'
choices: 'The times are different so it's fine'

day3_night_dain_priority.name: Dain
day3_night_dain_priority.text: 'Really?! Hehe, then it's fine! I'll show you something cool tomorrow!'

day3_night_dain_honest.name: Dain
day3_night_dain_honest.text: '...I see? Well, can't help it. But you HAVE to come to my practice!'

day3_night_dain_excuse.name: Dain
day3_night_dain_excuse.text: 'Hmm... well, if the times work out, I guess it's okay. But focus on me!'

day3_night_dain_normal.name: Dain
day3_night_dain_normal.text: *Additional message* 'Let's go get tteokbokki after practice! My treat! 🍜'

day3_night_msg_nurse.name: School Nurse
day3_night_msg_nurse.text: *Message: 11 PM* 'My cute transfer student, still awake? Hehe.'

day3_night_nurse_2.name: School Nurse
day3_night_nurse_2.text: 'You haven't forgotten Sunday evening, right? I'll prepare something special. 😉'

day3_night_nurse_excited.name: School Nurse
day3_night_nurse_excited.text: 'You can look forward to it. Sleep well and see you Sunday, {name}. 💋'

day3_night_nurse_curious.name: School Nurse
day3_night_nurse_curious.text: 'It's a secret. You'll find out on Sunday. Look forward to it.'

day3_night_msg_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_night_msg_teacher.text: *Message: 10 PM* '{name}, you haven't forgotten about the museum on Sunday, have you?'

day3_night_teacher_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_night_teacher_2.text: 'I'm excited since it's been a while since I had an outing. Sunday at 2 PM, museum entrance.'

day3_night_teacher_good.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_night_teacher_good.text: 'Alright, sleep well and see you Sunday. Good night.'

day3_night_no_message.name: Me
day3_night_no_message.text: *No special messages. What should I do this weekend...*

day3_night_ignore_all.name: Me
day3_night_ignore_all.text: *I decided to just sleep without checking messages. I'll read them tomorrow morning...*

day3_night_sleep.name: Me
day3_night_sleep.text: *Just as my eyes are closing... my phone rings. A call.*

day3_night_phone_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_phone_seoyeon.text: *I answer the phone to hear Seoyeon's voice* "...{name}? I know it's time to sleep. But... I wanted to hear your voice."

day3_night_phone_seoyeon_freetalk.name: Me
day3_night_phone_seoyeon_freetalk.text: *Having a late-night call with Seoyeon. Her voice sounds softer than usual in the dark room.*
day3_night_phone_seoyeon_freetalk.context: Late-night phone call. Seoyeon called saying 'I wanted to hear your voice.' A sweet late-night conversation. Seoyeon suddenly called before bed.

day3_night_phone_yuna.name: Yuna
day3_night_phone_yuna.text: *I answer the phone to hear Yuna's voice* "...I know it's time to sleep. But... I can't fall asleep."

day3_night_phone_yuna_freetalk.name: Me
day3_night_phone_yuna_freetalk.text: *Having a late-night call with Yuna. Her quiet breathing reaches my ear.*
day3_night_phone_yuna_freetalk.context: Late-night phone call. Yuna called saying 'I can't fall asleep.' A quiet and intimate late-night conversation. Her soft breathing feels close.

day3_night_phone_dain.name: Dain
day3_night_phone_dain.text: *I answer the phone to hear Dain's voice* "...Hey, I know it's late. But thinking about tomorrow, I can't sleep!"

day3_night_phone_dain_freetalk.name: Me
day3_night_phone_dain_freetalk.text: *Having a late-night call with Dain. Instead of her usual energy, her quiet voice feels new.*
day3_night_phone_dain_freetalk.context: Late-night phone call. Dain called saying 'Thinking about tomorrow, I can't sleep!' Unusually quiet Dain. A soft late-night atmosphere.

day3_night_phone_nurse.name: School Nurse
day3_night_phone_nurse.text: *I answer the phone to hear the nurse's voice* "...{name}? Still awake? I couldn't sleep either."

day3_night_phone_nurse_freetalk.name: Me
day3_night_phone_nurse_freetalk.text: *Having a late-night call with the school nurse. Her low voice reaches my ear.*
day3_night_phone_nurse_freetalk.context: Late-night phone call. The school nurse called saying 'I couldn't sleep.' Her low, gentle voice. A forbidden love's late-night call.

day3_night_phone_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_night_phone_teacher.text: *I answer the phone to hear the teacher's voice* "...{name}? Still awake? I know it's bedtime, but..."

day3_night_phone_teacher_freetalk.name: Me
day3_night_phone_teacher_freetalk.text: *Having a late-night call with the homeroom teacher. Her quiet voice sounds close.*
day3_night_phone_teacher_freetalk.context: Late-night phone call. The homeroom teacher called saying 'I know it's bedtime, but...' Her quiet voice. A forbidden love's late-night call.

day3_night_phone_end.name: Me
day3_night_phone_end.text: *I hang up and put down my phone. The lingering echo of her voice... makes my heart race.*

day3_night_sleep_2.name: Me
day3_night_sleep_2.text: *My eyes are closing. Tomorrow is Saturday... What kind of day will it be.*

day3_night_sleep_final.name: Me
day3_night_sleep_final.text: *Multiple plans swirl through my mind. Can I satisfy everyone...?*

day3_night_nightmare.name: Me
day3_night_nightmare.text: *...I dream. Voices echo from a dark space.*

day3_night_nightmare_voice1.text: *Seoyeon's voice echoes* "...You'll only see me, right? You promised. We pinky swore..."

day3_night_nightmare_voice2.text: *Yuna's voice whispers coldly* "...I said you'd regret it if you betray me, remember?"

day3_night_nightmare_voice3.text: *Dain's voice trembles* "...Idiot! You said you'd come! You said you wouldn't stand me up..."

day3_night_nightmare_choice.name: Me
day3_night_nightmare_choice.text: *Hands reach out from the darkness. Whose hand will I take...*

day3_night_nightmare_end.name: Me
day3_night_nightmare_end.text: *I reached out, but... there was nothing to hold. Everyone vanished, leaving only darkness and regret.*

day3_night_nightmare_wake.name: Me
day3_night_nightmare_wake.text: *...I snap awake. My heart is pounding like crazy. It was a dream. But... what will tomorrow bring?*

day3_night_peaceful.name: Me
day3_night_peaceful.text: *A peaceful night. I'm looking forward to tomorrow.*

day3_night_loyalty_seoyeon.name: Me
day3_night_loyalty_seoyeon.text: *...Just thinking about Seoyeon makes me smile. Tomorrow is our time together. I'll make sure to tell her how I truly feel.*

day3_night_loyalty_yuna.name: Me
day3_night_loyalty_yuna.text: *...Just thinking about Yuna makes my heart race. Tomorrow night, just the two of us. Will I finally see the real Yuna?*

day3_night_loyalty_dain.name: Me
day3_night_loyalty_dain.text: *...Thinking of Dain's smile makes me smile too. I wonder how happy she'll be when I show up to watch her practice tomorrow.*

day3_night_loyalty_nurse.name: Me
day3_night_loyalty_nurse.text: *...The school nurse's face comes to mind. It's a forbidden relationship, but... I can't hide these feelings.*

day3_night_loyalty_teacher.name: Me
day3_night_loyalty_teacher.text: *...The homeroom teacher's smile comes to mind. We're teacher and student, but... my feelings are real.*

day3_final_scene.name: Me
day3_final_scene.text: *Friday night deepens... Tomorrow is finally Saturday.*
